characters.name: Sparky
characters.appearance: tiny, plump purple dragon with small, iridescent wings and a short, wagging tail

scenes.setting: festive dining table with a birthday cake

shots.description: A colorful birthday cake with a single candle sits on a table adorned with streamers. Sparky flies into view.
Sparky hovers close to the unlit candle, looking determined.

scenes.setting: festive dining table with a birthday cake

shots.description: Close-up on Sparky's snout as a tiny wisp of smoke emerges, failing to light the candle.
Sparky puffs out his chest, taking a deep breath, eyes squinting in concentration.

scenes.setting: festive dining table with a birthday cake

shots.description: Sparky's face scrunches up, building to a powerful sneeze.
Sparky lets out a fiery sneeze, a stream of flame missing the candle but hitting a nearby party hat, which instantly ignites.

scenes.setting: festive dining table with a birthday cake

shots.description: Sparky's eyes widen in shock, his mouth agape, looking at the burning hat.
Sparky hovers guiltily, looking from the still-unlit candle to the smoldering party hat.
